subject: Update redis keyword to valkey in some sentinel functions (Redis Legacy) (#706)
reason: The change is a pure rename refactor in src/sentinel.c: sentinelRedisInstance and related functions/types are renamed to sentinelValkeyInstance, redisAeEvents to ValkeyAeEvents, and the REDIS_SENTINEL_PORT macro to VALKEY_SENTINEL_PORT with the same value (26379). Every hunk is an identifier or comment rename with identical logic; no command reply, protocol output, config option, default value, or control flow is altered, so there is no observable behaviour difference between the two builds for any scenario to exercise.
